# PrivacyKit

> Free, client-side browser-based cybersecurity and privacy tools. No login required, no data leaves your browser.

PrivacyKit provides free tools to help users check password strength, look up IP geolocation, and check for email data breaches, all running entirely in the browser with zero server-side data collection.

## Tools

- [Password Strength Checker](https://privacykit.tech/tools/password-checker): Analyze password strength, entropy, and estimated crack time entirely in your browser.
- [IP Geolocation Lookup](https://privacykit.tech/tools/ip-lookup): Look up geographic location, ISP, timezone, and threat details for any IP address.
- [Email Breach Checker](https://privacykit.tech/tools/breach-checker): Check whether an email address has appeared in known data breaches using k-Anonymity privacy.

## Educational Articles & Guides

- [Blog Index](https://privacykit.tech/blog): Digital privacy guides, cybersecurity best practices, and threat awareness articles.
- [How Strong Is Your Password?](https://privacykit.tech/blog/how-strong-is-your-password): Complete guide on password security, entropy, and crack times.
- [What Does an IP Address Tell You?](https://privacykit.tech/blog/what-does-your-ip-address-reveal): In-depth guide explaining what an IP address exposes, IPv4 vs IPv6, public vs private IPs, and location privacy.
- [What Is a Data Breach?](https://privacykit.tech/blog/what-is-a-data-breach): Guide explaining how data breaches happen and immediate steps to secure compromised accounts.
- [What Is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?](https://privacykit.tech/blog/what-is-two-factor-authentication): Comprehensive introduction to 2FA and multi-factor authentication methods.
- [How to Create a Strong Password](https://privacykit.tech/blog/how-to-create-a-strong-password): Step-by-step strategies for generating memorable, highly secure passwords.
